title: Ashen Cantor Mauler
text: Ashen Cantor Mauler turns a work chant into measured blows from a soot-black hammer. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The final verse is written in dents.

defeatReward.text: Ashen Cantor Mauler is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
